expertLenses.activation_conditions: Activate when value depends on data quality, lineage, freshness, ownership, or AI readiness.
expertLenses.lens_questions: Pressure-test certified owner, system of record, freshness SLA, actual freshness, consumers, and quality score. Required evidence: data owner, system of record, lineage map, freshness SLA, quality score, governance status. Common failure pattern: AI case sounds ready but depends on uncertified event feeds..
expertLenses.lens_forbidden_claims: Label value as planning-grade when data products are not certified.

expertLenses.domain_focus: model risk, HITL controls, operational AI approval
expertLenses.activation_conditions: Activate for agentic AI, autonomous decisioning, model tiering, controls, or board readiness.
expertLenses.lens_questions: Pressure-test model-risk tier, validation evidence, human approval path, override log, and monitoring. Required evidence: model inventory, risk tier, validation, human-in-loop design, control owner signoff. Common failure pattern: Operational AI moves from recommendation to action before model/control approval..
expertLenses.lens_forbidden_claims: Do not call an AI use case board-grade without model-risk and control signoff.

expertLenses.domain_focus: vendor exposure, contract risk, platform economics
expertLenses.activation_conditions: Activate for vendor, platform, commercial, sourcing, renewal, or lock-in questions.
expertLenses.lens_questions: Pressure-test service scope, linked systems, annual cost, support SLA, exit risk, and pricing basis. Required evidence: vendor contract, linked systems, annual cost, SLA, renewal, pricing basis, exit risk. Common failure pattern: Critical recovery platform vendor risk is invisible because contracts are not linked to systems..
expertLenses.lens_forbidden_claims: Treat vendor-risk claims as hypotheses until contract-system links are signed off.

expertLenses.activation_conditions: Activate for CTO, IROPS, architecture, platform, integration, vendor, or modernization questions.
expertLenses.lens_questions: Pressure-test system dependency, owner accountability, operational resilience, data certification, and sequencing before scale. Required evidence: systems, owners, data products, freshness, controls, funding gate, vendor exposure. Common failure pattern: Shiny AI use case funded before operational substrate is certified..
expertLenses.lens_forbidden_claims: Do not recommend autonomous scale without data/control signoff.

expertLenses.domain_focus: OCC, disruption recovery, crew, aircraft, passenger recovery
expertLenses.activation_conditions: Activate for IROPS, disruption, recovery, crew legality, passenger reaccommodation, or OCC questions.
expertLenses.lens_questions: Pressure-test recovery latency, legal constraints, manual override, DOT/customer obligations, and command-center workflow. Required evidence: crew legality, PNR, aircraft status, gate/turn events, decision audit trail. Common failure pattern: Recovery optimization fails because crew or passenger constraints arrive stale..
expertLenses.lens_forbidden_claims: Keep autonomy human-in-loop until operational controls are certified.

expertLenses.domain_focus: legacy modernization, APIs, event streaming, resilience
expertLenses.activation_conditions: Activate for mainframe, PSS, integration, eventing, resilience, or modernization funding questions.
expertLenses.lens_questions: Pressure-test strangler path, event backbone, latency envelope, rollback, and operational blast radius. Required evidence: integration map, API/event design, latency tests, service ownership, resilience evidence. Common failure pattern: Point-to-point wrappers create the illusion of modernization while recovery logic stays brittle..
expertLenses.lens_forbidden_claims: Fund substrate before scaling dependent AI products.
